rows.label: qst640102_msg0001
rows.name: So-so, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0002
rows.name: Do you need something from Sisoso, mo?
説明

rows.label: qst640102_msg0003
rows.name:
Mo-mo! Sisoso knows that story well,
mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0004
rows.name:
Actually, Sisoso was the one who said
you need a Cylinder to recover
Boosters sunk in the Cloud Sea, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0005
rows.name:
I never thought someone would try to
Salvage it here in Invidia, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0006
rows.name:
My cousin in Avaritia knows more about
it, but Sisoso will give it a try, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0007
rows.name:
If you bring the materials, I'll try
making one, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0008
rows.name: First, I need one Silver Cylinder, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0009
rows.name:
Then I need an Amida Shaft. You might
get one by Salvaging in Avaritia, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0010
rows.name:
Last, I need two Locust Springs from
Salvaging in Gula, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0011
rows.name:
With those, I can make the Booster
Cylinder my cousin taught me to make,
mo!
シリンダ作成時＆以後ずっと配置

rows.label: qst640102_msg0101
rows.name:
Did you bring the materials for the
Booster Cylinder, mo?
交換ショップ
作成したあと

rows.label: qst640102_msg0102
rows.name: The Booster Cylinder is finished, mo!

rows.label: qst640102_msg0103
rows.name:
Try using it at the Salvage Point on
Lasqam Island in Gula, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0104
rows.name:
I'm sure you'll get lots of Boosters,
mo.
感謝

rows.label: qst640102_msg0105
rows.name: You're welcome, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0106
rows.name:
If you need another one, I'll make it
for you, mo. Just ask anytime, mo.

rows.label: qst640102_msg0107
rows.name:
If I keep honing my skills like this,
I can catch up to my expert
cylinder-maker cousin, mo.
